title: College Research Administration Manager
description:
Overview

Howard University seeks a dynamic and skilled College Research Administration Manager to oversee research administration activities within assigned colleges. This hybrid reporting role is pivotal to advancing the university’s R1 research mission by ensuring compliance, enhancing research productivity, and maintaining efficient workflows. The manager will handle pre- and post-award responsibilities, working collaboratively with the Office of Research, college leadership, Principal Investigators (PIs), and other stakeholders.

Nature And Scope

Serve as the primary point of contact for all assigned departments within the college for pre-award and post-award support. This position reports to the Office of Research for strategic oversight, training, and compliance, with a dotted-line relationship to the Associate Dean for Research to align daily priorities with college needs. The incumbent bridges central oversight and college-specific needs to ensure the success of research activities across the institution. External contacts include representatives from the federal government, other colleges and universities, professional associations, consultants, vendors, and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities

Pre-Award Management

  • Guide PIs in preparing and submitting grant proposals, including budgets, narratives, and compliance documentation.
  • Serve as the primary liaison for grant submissions to central research offices and funding agencies.
  • Review and approve proposals for adherence to university, federal, and sponsor guidelines.

Post-Award Management

  • Oversee grant account setups, cost distributions, and personnel appointments on awarded projects.
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, local, and university policies regarding allowable costs, effort reporting, and project amendments.
  • Monitor project budgets and expenditures, providing timely financial reports and projections.

Compliance and Reporting

  • Facilitate the preparation and submission of internal and external reports, including progress, compliance, and financial reports.
  • Collaborate with university compliance offices to address regulatory requirements and audit findings.

Training and Development

  • Conduct training sessions for PIs, departmental staff, and other stakeholders on research administration policies and systems.
  • Participate in university-wide discussions on process improvement and best practices in research administration.

Collaboration and Oversight

  • Work with the Associate Dean for Research to align daily operations with college priorities.
  • Maintain active collaboration with the Office of Research to ensure consistent training, compliance, and professional development across colleges.
  • Act as a resource for faculty and staff in navigating research administration challenges.

Core Competencies

  • Experience in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment with a high degree of accuracy and organization; strong time management and attention to detail; ability to coordinate multiple activities and reprioritize as needed.
  • Effective communication with investigators and internal and external stakeholders; ability to interpret and convey technical contract language and liaise with granting agencies, University administration, and principal investigators.

Minimum Requirements

  • BA, BBA, or BS (foreign equivalent or higher) in Business, Finance, Accounting, or related fields and 5 years of professional experience in research administration.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.
  • Advanced knowledge of federal, state, and local regulations governing sponsored research, including Uniform Guidance and FAR clauses.
  • Excellent communication skills, including conveying complex concepts to non-specialist audiences.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional, fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency in research administration systems (e.g., Cayuse, Workday).

Note: This position description does not imply exclusive standards and the university reserves the right to revise this description. This description is not a contract of employment.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Pay Range: $90,909 - $100,000

Nosso time é formado por excelentes profissionais da área da tecnologia.

Colaboração e comprometimento fazem parte do nosso dia-a-dia, quando desenvolvemos novas funcionalidades, construindo um produto robusto e escalável.

Fazendo parte de nossa equipe, seu trabalho irá impactar em milhares de usuários, de algumas das maiores empresas do país, que utilizam nossa solução diariamente.


Main responsibilities

Objetivo da Função:

Garantir a supervisão, coordenação e evolução contínua das operações do NOC, assegurando a disponibilidade, confiabilidade e eficiência dos serviços de TI e Telecom, além da liderança da equipe técnica.

Responsabilidades

Gestão Operacional

Coordenar as atividades diárias do NOC, assegurando atendimento dentro dos SLAs.

Monitorar incidentes críticos e garantir tratativas rápidas e eficazes.

Implementar planos de contingência e recuperação de falhas.

Planejar escalas e turnos de operação para garantir cobertura total 24x7.

Gerenciar alarmes e eventos de monitoramento proativos, acionando equipes conforme necessário.

Supervisionar abertura e fechamento de chamados críticos, garantindo registros completos.

Garantir que todos os procedimentos de backup e redundância sejam corretamente executados.

Validar e aprovar mudanças de configuração, deploys e atualizações de sistemas críticos.

Assegurar cumprimento das normas de segurança da informação durante operações críticas.

Acompanhar manutenção preventiva e corretiva de equipamentos de rede e servidores.

Revisar diariamente dashboards e alertas para identificar potenciais incidentes antes que se tornem críticos.

Implementar controles operacionais e realizar ajustes contínuos em procedimentos.

Assegurar a correta execução dos procedimentos atuais e dos que venham a ser desenvolvidos.

Promover relatórios e indicadores recorrentes para gestão e clientes.

Acompanhar métricas de desempenho (KPIs) e gerar relatórios executivos.

Gestão de Pessoas

Supervisionar a equipe de analistas, distribuindo demandas de forma equilibrada.

Desenvolver e treinar colaboradores, promovendo evolução técnica e profissional.

Realizar feedbacks periódicos e avaliações de performance.

Escalonar e engajar equipes de suporte de segundo/terceiro nível quando necessário.

Planejar e conduzir treinamentos internos para atualização técnica e de processos.

Garantir disponibilidade de horário para cobertura eventual de demandas, incluindo afastamentos (atestados), férias e regime de sobreaviso.

Promover integração da equipe e criar cultura de colaboração e proatividade.

Acompanhar performance individual e coletiva, implementando planos de melhoria quando necessário.

Delegar responsabilidades operacionais mantendo controle sobre resultados.

Realizar reuniões individuais com analistas para desenvolvimento de carreira e alinhamento de metas.

Processos e Melhoria Contínua

Garantir aderência a procedimentos e políticas internas (POPs, ITIL, ISO, etc.).

Propor e implementar melhorias em processos, ferramentas e fluxos de trabalho.

Liderar revisões pós-incidente (post-mortem) e planos de ação corretiva.

Atuar na automação de tarefas e integração de sistemas de monitoramento.

Implementar, revisar, ajustar e fiscalizar a aplicação de procedimentos operacionais periodicamente.

Mapear processos críticos do NOC e identificar gaps de eficiência.

Padronizar procedimentos de escalonamento e registro de incidentes.

Implementar controles de qualidade sobre atendimento de tickets e monitoramento.

Revisar periodicamente SLAs, OLAs e contratos de suporte para adequação às necessidades do cliente.

Garantir atualização de documentação técnica e procedimentos operacionais.

Reduzir falhas operacionais devido à padronização de processos.

Relacionamento e Comunicação

Ser o ponto de contato entre o NOC e outras áreas de TI, Facilities e fornecedores.

Reportar status de incidentes críticos para gestores e clientes em tempo real.

Preparar comunicados internos e externos sobre mudanças ou interrupções.

Apoiar auditorias internas e externas fornecendo informações técnicas e operacionais.

Conduzir reuniões semanais de alinhamento com a equipe e gestão.

Participar de reuniões internas e externas com áreas parceiras, clientes e fornecedores para alinhamentos operacionais e estratégicos.

Comunicar proativamente riscos de incidentes e vulnerabilidades para a gestão.

Assegurar alinhamento entre diferentes áreas envolvidas em operações críticas.

Manter registro de decisões e ações acordadas em reuniões estratégicas.

Fornecer suporte de comunicação durante incidentes maiores, garantindo transparência para stakeholders.

Participação ativa e contribuição em reuniões internas, externas e estratégicas.

Infraestrutura e Ativos

Coordenar atividades de cabeamento estruturado (cabling).

Realizar e acompanhar a certificação de cabos de rede.

Gerenciar o controle de estoque de materiais de infraestrutura e insumos do NOC.

Organizar o armazenamento adequado de servidores, periféricos e equipamentos de rede.

Acompanhar a movimentação, substituição e manutenção preventiva de ativos de hardware.

Planejar expansão de racks e infraestrutura conforme demandas futuras.

Garantir inventário atualizado de todos os ativos sob responsabilidade do NOC.

Supervisionar testes de conectividade e validação de novos equipamentos.

Implementar práticas de armazenamento seguro para servidores, switches, roteadores e periféricos críticos.

Assegurar descarte correto de equipamentos obsoletos ou com defeito.

Indicadores de Sucesso (KPIs)

Cumprimento dos SLAs de disponibilidade.

Redução do MTTR (Mean Time to Repair).

Taxa de incidentes recorrentes.

Satisfação do cliente interno/externo.

Engajamento e performance da equipe.

Participação e eficácia em reuniões semanais e treinamentos internos.

Conformidade e aderência aos procedimentos estabelecidos.

Efetividade no atendimento a demandas emergenciais em regime de sobreaviso e coberturas eventuais de férias e atestados.

Controle adequado de estoque e correta certificação de cabeamento.

Organização física e documental dos servidores e periféricos sob responsabilidade do NOC.

Tempo de resposta e resolução de incidentes dentro dos parâmetros definidos.

Nível de aderência às boas práticas de ITIL e POPs internos.


Requirements and skills

Formação:

Graduação completa nas seguintes áreas: Análise de Sistemas, Ciência da Computação, Processamento de Dados, Sistemas de Informação, Informática, Engenharia da Computação ou demais áreas de Tecnologia da Informação.


Additional information

Nossos benefícios:

  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Seguro Prudential: é concedido ao colaborador, de forma gratuita o seguro de vida, auxílio funeral e cesta natalidade, conforme regras específicas da seguradora;
  • Vale Refeição ou Vale Alimentação;

  • Day off: será concedido ao colaborador folga em virtude do dia do aniversário, devendo este ser usufruído na mesma data e/ou no mês do aniversário;

  • Ginástica Laboral.

title: Project Manager
description:
To Apply

When applying for the position, on the screening questions, please submit a video or audio, sharing your most complex project management experience, including strategies you used to improve operations or challenges you overcame, and explaining the tools or platforms you use to manage your day-to-day projects and team.

Applications without this submission will not be considered.

Location: Remote / Massachusetts-based preferred

Employment Type: Full-Time (8am - 6pm EST)

Hourly Rate : Based on experience and performance

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly organized, tech-savvy, and results-oriented Project Manager to take full ownership of our project execution process. This role is critical to ensuring every marketing product is delivered on time, on budget, and exceeds client expectations. You’ll be the central hub between our internal team, freelancers, and clients, keeping projects on track, holding everyone accountable, and leading initiatives from concept to completion.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan & Execute: Develop detailed project plans, timelines, and deliverables for all marketing product launches and campaigns.
  • Own the Process: Manage every layer of the business related to product fulfillment, from creative development to final delivery.
  • Technology-Driven: Use project management tools (ClickUp, Asana, Trello, CRM, automations, etc.) to track progress, assign tasks, and maintain deadlines.
  • Leadership & Accountability: Lead team meetings, delegate effectively, and ensure all team members and freelancers meet performance expectations.
  • Client Experience: Oversee client communications during fulfillment, ensuring we deliver a premium experience and exceptional results.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify bottlenecks, create process efficiencies, and improve workflows to maximize productivity and quality.
  • Team Growth: Recruit, onboard, and manage future hires and freelancers as the company scales.
  • AI & Innovation: Explore, implement, and optimize AI tools to enhance workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and improve client deliverables.
  • Client Communication & Reporting: Serve as the primary point of contact for clients regarding project status, timelines, and deliverables.
  • Budget & Resource Management: Track project budgets and ensure all resources are used efficiently. Approve or flag overages before they become issues.
  • Quality Control & Compliance: Review marketing assets before they go live to ensure accuracy, brand alignment, and legal compliance.
  • Metrics & Performance Tracking: Define KPIs for campaigns and internal workflows.

Requirements

  • Fluent in English (written and spoken).
  • Proven Experience as a Project Manager, Operations Manager, or similar leadership role in marketing, advertising, or a fast-paced service-based business.
  • Exceptional Organization Skills — obsessive attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects at once without dropping the ball.
  • Tech-Savvy — mastery of project management software, CRM systems, and digital communication tools.
  • Strong Leadership Abilities — confident in directing a team, holding people accountable, and driving results.
  • Excellent Communication Skills — both written and verbal, with the ability to simplify complex tasks and keep everyone aligned.
  • Problem-Solver Mindset — thrives in challenges, quickly finds solutions, and proactively removes obstacles.
  • Results-Driven Mentality — focused on meeting deadlines, delivering quality, and exceeding expectations.
  • AI-Savvy: Comfortable using AI tools for project management, content creation, workflow automation, or data analysis (e.g., ChatGPT, MidJourney, Jasper, Zapier with AI integrations, or similar).
  • Ability to identify opportunities to implement solutions to improve efficiency, accuracy, and delivery speed.
  • Proactive communication — anticipating issues before they arise.
  • Attention to trends — stays up-to-date with digital marketing best practices and AI innovations.
  • Flexible to occasionally work outside standard hours to meet client deadlines, coordinate with team members in different time zones, or handle urgent campaign issues.

Preferred Skills (Nice to Have)

  • Experience in a marketing agency or similar environment.
  • Background in client services, business or account management.
  • Experience hiring and managing teams and freelancers.

This Job Fits You If…

  • You are obsessed with organization — nothing slips through the cracks, timelines are precise, and details are always accounted for.
  • You naturally take charge in any group and people look to you for direction.
  • You thrive under pressure and see deadlines as a challenge, not a burden.
  • You can juggle multiple projects without losing sight of quality or client satisfaction.
  • You are tech-obsessed — you love learning new software, building workflows, and making systems run more efficiently.
  • You believe in radical accountability — you own the wins, the mistakes, and the outcomes.
  • You know how to bring out the best in people — whether they’re employees, freelancers, or clients.
  • You genuinely enjoy leading from the front and making sure the team hits every goal, every time.
  • Speak English (Fluent or Native)

You are flexible to occasionally work outside standard hours to meet client deadlines, coordinate with team members in different time zones, or handle urgent campaign issues.

Job Types

  • Full-time
  • Contract

Pay : From R$20.00 per hour

Expected hours : 40 – 50 per week

Application Question(s)

  • Are you available 8am to 6pm EST with flexibility outside normal hours?
  • Please submit a video or audio, sharing your most complex project management experience, including strategies you used to improve operations or challenges you overcame, and explaining the tools or platforms you use to manage your day-to-day projects and team. (Applications without this submission will not be considered.)
  • Kindly share your hourly rate or salary expectations
  • Please confirm that you have carefully read the full job description and affirm that you possess the skills, experience, and qualifications required for this position.

Experience

  • 3 years as a Project Manager (Required)

Language

  • English (Required)

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Senior Accountant will ensure the integrity of accounting and prepares accurate and timely financial statements and documents, in line with local GAAP and IFRS. Responsible for month end close activities; responsible for performing balance sheet, revenue, expense, and payroll account reconciliations, as well as executing accounts payable and accounts receivable processes. Assists with external audit, budgets and special projects as needed. To manage, supervising and motivate a small team of Accountants and provide effective guidance and leadership.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Leading function in Month End and Year End closing activities.
  • Verifying and performing payments to suppliers & manage cash flow, and ensures all payments are properly approved prior payment.
  • To review transactions to assure accounting treatment is in accordance with IFRS and with internal accounting regulations.
  • To review general ledger accounts and makes necessary journal entries including posting monthly, quarterly and yearly accruals.
  • To prepare and record Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable & Fixed Assets entries by compiling and analysing account information.
  • To post payroll entries, to reconcile of social charges, bonus accrual and pay out.
  • To analyse and review company expenditures.
  • Produce error-free accounting reports and present their results.
  • Participate in financial standards setting and in forecast process.
  • Assist with tax audits, and tax returns and consumption tax returns.
  • Lead, plan, assign and review staff’s work.
  • Ensure compliance with IFRS and FIFA Accounting principles.
  • To provide necessary support for internal customers and external auditors.
  • To seek ways to improve upon accounting processes and procedures.
  • To assist the Head of Finance and the management on special requests.

YOUR PROFILE

Experience and qualifications

  • Degree in Accounting
  • Proven experience (4 years or more) as accounting supervisor and/or senior accountant
  • Experience in an international environment
  • Experience using/maintaining a financial ERP model (e.g. SAP)
  • Experience in Event Finance of advantage
  • Experience in procurement of advantage
  • Good communication skills, ability to communicate effectively in English (oral and written)
  • Very good sense for responsibility
  • Ability to work independently and with a team in a fast-paced and high-volume environment.
  • Focus on accuracy and timeliness, attention to detail
  • Confidentiality
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Based in Rio de Janeiro

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women\'s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Responsibilities

  • Identify and develop advanced analytics use cases to resolve complex technical challenges, optimize processes, enhance revenue, ensure environmental sustainability, and improve safety.
  • Drive ideas from conception to production using best-in-class Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) and Development Operations (DevOps) practices.
  • Develop and optimize Machine Learning (ML) models and pipelines, ensuring their efficient deployment, monitoring, and scaling.
  • Explore diverse data sources to improve predictive modeling and optimize business strategies.

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. Our critical communications, video security and command center technologies support public safety agencies and enterprises alike, enabling the coordination that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals and safer businesses. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview

Community & Intelligence Engineering. The product is Assist Chat.

Job Description

Why This Role

Assist Chat is our flagship conversational AI for public safety—already live in 9-1-1 centers, patrol vehicles, and real-time crime centers. We’ve built the interface. We’ve embedded it into workflows. Now we’re scaling the intelligence behind it.

This AI/ML Engineer role is an opportunity to push the frontier of how public safety professionals interact with language models in high-stakes environments.

Your Mission

  • Build, fine-tune, and evaluate LLMs and task-specific agents for public safety workflows.
  • Develop safe, performant pipelines for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), structured data injection, summarization, and classification.
  • Collaborate with product, design, and engineering to embed AI directly into real-time workflows —no labs, no “eventual” use cases.
  • Design and optimize evaluation frameworks , including offline metrics and human-in-the-loop validation.
  • Work on problems that bridge research and production : speed, hallucination risk, latency, data ambiguity, and feedback integration.
  • Collaborate with AI researchers and responsible AI team to build the best possible AI solutions for our customers.

What You Bring

  • 3–8+ years working in ML/AI engineering roles—shipping models or pipelines into production.

  • Familiarity with LLM ecosystems (OpenAI, Claude, Mistral, Llama, etc.) and modern AI stacks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Ray, Hugging Face).

  • Experience with RAG pipelines , prompt engineering, prompt chaining, and fine-tuning preferred.

  • Strong programming skills in Python development and testing (and ideally some experience working alongside full-stack engineers).

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (Azure, AWS, GCP), containerization (Docker/kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Pragmatism—able to operate in applied, real-world settings with real constraints.

title: WHS Delivery Station Manager , Workplace Health and Safety (WHS)
description:
Overview

The WHS Delivery Station Manager will be responsible for 5 to 7 Delivery Stations to execute company Safety policies and ensure compliance to all applicable local and regional regulations. By leveraging lean principles and kaizens, this individual will lead continuous improvement initiatives to reduce conditional and ergonomic risk in our processes to ensure a safe and healthful working environment for our Associates. The WHS Delivery Station Manager must demonstrate the ability to build trust and confidence with the Operations Team and influence change through providing comprehensive risk assessments and safety data analysis. The WHS Delivery Station Manager must be an effective communicator and send clear, concise and consistent messages, both verbally and in writing. This individual must instruct and train Operations Leaders in company WHS policies and assist the regional teams in incorporating our WHS standards at their sites. The WHS Delivery Station Manager will be required to identify best practices and incorporate these best practices into our standards to continuously improve company Safety policies. The WHS Delivery Station Manager will be required to possess WHS program and relevant safety, environmental and ergonomic knowledge and demonstrates this expertise when working with Operations. The WHS Delivery Station Manager will be responsible to lead a team of WHS Officers in their region. This individual must create and execute leadership development plans for their WHS Associates on their team. They must communicate safety team expectations and give frequent and appropriate feedback to their WHS teams and ensure they are executing to the core competencies of an Amazon professional. This individual must also demonstrate the ability to judge and assess WHS talent and select appropriate bench strength to current and future business needs.

Key job responsibilities

  • Manage overall compliance with local requirements and authorities.
  • Provide guidance and oversight to ensure compliance to all applicable Amazon WHS Policies and regulatory requirements
  • Measure the regions and sites’ performance against published requirements in WHS policies. For all deficiencies, identify a plan for the site to implement and fix all identified deficiencies.
  • Ensure WHS recordkeeping and data integrity and provides Operations with accurate reporting and metrics to support business WHS initiatives.
  • Deliver on-time and quality projects to Operations. Deliver quality projects on time to Operations.
  • Analyze WHS metrics and review incident weekly and monthly incident trends to discover trends to justify the allocation of appropriate resources to areas where the safety risk is highest.
  • Audit recordkeeping practices and Global WHS Database entries to ensure compliance to global WHS standards and local regulations.
  • Audit the workplace organization and Associate behaviors to ensure that training, auditing and scoring methods are accurate and consistent.
  • Manage and mentor the region WHS Officers and WHS Associates in your assigned sites.
  • Spend time at the sortation centers, and delivery stations, and seek input from WHS teams, Associates and leaders on WHS program improvement opportunities.
  • Ensure open communication on status of progress and resolution against these suggestions.
  • Ensure site leadership and Associates are trained and knowledgeable of their responsibilities under each policy. Audit the quality, delivery (including qualifications of the trainer), and effectiveness of all required WHS training.
  • Review for effectiveness the deployed WHS tools and revise to ensure continual improvement.
  • Partner with corporate and other regional field WHS personnel to leverage global WHS standards.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelors Degree;
  • Experience in WHS programs in manufacturing, production, or service operations;
  • Knowledge of Brazilian Regulations and Technical Standards;
  • Experience designing and implementing WHS policy, processes and procedural documentation;
  • Experience in People Management;
  • Available to work flexible shifts including days, nights and/or weekends;
  • English skills.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Environmental, Ergonomics or a related field required;
  • Mobility to Brazil regions;
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and the use of pivot tables and the development of charts and graphics; Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including comfort collaborating with site leaders; Exhibit excellent root cause analysis, problem solving, training skills and attention to detail;
  • Ability to adapt well to fast-paced environments with changing circumstances, direction, and strategy;
  • The credibility and influencing skills and strategies to be able to build buy-in to change.

Assegurar a conformidade regulatória e a certificação naval dos FPSOs, atuando como ponto focal junto à Marinha, Bandeira e Sociedades Classificadoras, gerindo ciclos de inspeção e auditoria, LSA, gestão de não conformidades e aderência ao Código ISM, de forma integrada aos processos de manutenção e operação, garantindo segurança operacional, continuidade de negócios e validade dos certificados estatutários.

Promover um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e motivador, estimulando o engajamento e a colaboração dos colegas de trabalho e da equipe. Atuar com foco em segurança operacional, excelência técnica e cultura de prevenção, garantindo que as atividades sejam realizadas com responsabilidade, eficiência e respeito à vida.

  • Atuar como ponto focal junto à Marinha, Bandeira e Sociedade Classificadora , coordenando comunicações institucionais, submissões documentais, solicitações de prorrogação e alinhamentos técnicos.
  • Planejar e conduzir ciclos de inspeção e auditoria estatutária e de classe, incluindo ISM, estruturando cronogramas por criticidade e janela operacional e integrando o plano no Flow e no SAP PM.
  • Preparar e liderar pré-inspeções e 'readiness reviews' para auditorias, montando pacotes de evidências, orientando a bordo os testes operacionais e endereçando gaps antes da visita.
  • Gerir não conformidades e findings, registrando evidências , classificando severidade e acompanhando o fechamento dentro do prazo acordado com a autoridade.
  • Desenvolver e controlar planos de ação corretiva e preventiva oriundos de inspeções e auditorias , priorizando riscos, endereçando causas raízes e reportando status a stakeholders.
  • Garantir a conformidade e certificação de LSA e Lifting Gear , planejando inspeções anuais e quinquenais, coordenando recertificações e assegurando validade de palamentas e balsas.
  • Manter a governança da documentação estatutária e de bandeira , atualizando bases, controlando versões e assegurando disponibilidade a bordo e em terra.
  • Avaliar integridade estrutural de casco e tanques e suportar extensão de vida útil , consolidando relatórios, definindo reparos com Classe e acompanhando implementação.
  • Coordenar testes operacionais durante auditorias , articulando equipes offshore para execução segura e rastreável.
  • Monitorar indicadores de conformidade , gerando relatórios executivos e suportando decisões de risco.
  • Assegurar aderência às exigências da ANP, ao Código ISM, NORMAM, regras de classe e demais normas e regulamentos aplicáveis, integrando padrões corporativos de HSE e alinhando evidências de conformidade de sistemas críticos.
  • Gerir fornecedores e contratos especializados , definindo escopos e critérios de aceite e acompanhando performance e HSE.
  • Promover cultura de conformidade e capacitação , realizando treinamentos e difundindo lições aprendidas.
  • Graduação completa em Engenharia Naval, Engenharia Mecânica ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Engenharia de Confiabilidade, Gestão de Ativos, Projetos ou áreas afins será considerado um diferencial.

Conhecimentos Técnicos Específicos:

  • Sólido conhecimento em normas técnicas e regulatórias aplicáveis à integridade de ativos offshore, API, ASME, DNV, ABS e normas da Marinha do Brasil.
  • Domínio de metodologias de inspeção baseadas em risco (RBI), análise de falhas (RCFA), gestão de anomalias e planos de inspeção e teste (ITP).

Ferramentas e Sistemas:

  • Experiência avançada com SAP PM para gestão de manutenção e inspeções, ferramentas de análise de dados como Excel avançado e Power BI, além de softwares de engenharia e modelagem estrutural (ex: AutoPIPE, ANSYS, OrcaFlex).
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão de projetos (MS Project, Primavera) e sistemas de controle de MOCs e não conformidades.

Certificações e Treinamentos Regulatórios:

  • Treinamentos obrigatórios para atuação offshore (CBSP, HUET, NR-10, NR-35, entre outros) devem estar atualizados conforme exigência legal.
  • Inglês avançado para leitura e fala, interpretação de normas técnicas internacionais, elaboração de relatórios e comunicação com entidades certificadoras e fornecedores.

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamento que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.
  • Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

title: Principal Product Engineer - Americas
description:
Hi I’m Abhik, Ashby’s Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. We’re looking for a versatile, persistent product engineer who’s not afraid to set up reusable building blocks across the stack and advocate for the time and space to do so. At Ashby, all our engineers ship features end-to-end at a high pace. Example is the best leadership. We’ll give you the room to do your best work, and you'll be our guide! If that speaks to you, read on.

What Ashby gives you in return is the best of both early and growth-stage environments. The agency and no-nonsense of a seed startup: you write product specs, make product and design decisions, and build in an almost-no-meeting culture. While also the product-market fit and scale of a growth-stage startup: tens of thousands of daily users who depend on your software and eagerly await your next feature.

We have notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, growing >100% year over year, very low churn, and many years of runway. We’ll share more details once we meet.

You’ve probably seen this role posted before, and it’s because we’re always expanding the team (we’re on track to double this year). We’re bubbling with ideas on how to support Talent Acquisition through software, and we’ve started the journey of building products beyond Talent Acquisition. We read every application and aim to respond to yours within 3-4 days (often sooner).

About the Role and How We Work

Our engineering culture strives to recreate the environments where we did our best work as ICs – where we had the ownership and agency to impact our users with creative and innovative software.

I started my career building software for artists in the Visual Effects industry. It was a formative experience for me as a software engineer because success relied on my ability to be a product manager and designer. I talked to artists to understand their needs. I came up with ideas. I did industry research, designed interfaces, and prototyped ideas. I watched artists use what I built and decided what to tackle in the next iteration. No daily stand-ups, no t-shirt sizing, no planning meetings.

I studied computer science to solve problems, not tickets, and this felt exactly like that. I not only felt creative and fulfilled but the agency and ownership we were given as engineers powered an incredible amount of innovation.

Innovation came differently (or not at all) at technology startups beyond the seed stage, often through an engineer’s force of will and ability to push back against culture (rather than any encouragement from it). Engineering was narrowed to implementation and delivery, partly due to the influence of other departments and partly due to the influx of Agile processes like sprint planning. In those companies, I felt like a JIRA jockey.

At Ashby, we’re building an environment that is optimistic about what engineers can own and achieve. An environment that embraces innovative engineers, and, frankly, often stays out of their way. As a Product Engineer, you’ll take ownership over a large portion of one of our products and own projects end-to-end (wearing hats traditionally worn by product and design). You’ll research competitors, write product specs, make wireframes, and more. To ground it with examples, product engineers at Ashby have:

  • Designed and built automated interview scheduling. This feature automates scheduling by calculating possible times from a pool of interviewers and other constraints, and then presenting these times to the candidate for selection via our responsive web app. This solves the “Calendar Tetris” problem I talk about in What We're Building.
  • Built a generalized declarative filter architecture that allows users to create complex filters for any record with a consistent UI and compile it to SQL in our backend. Many user-facing features use it.
  • Specced, designed, and implemented a feature that allows users to complete signing offers entirely within Ashby. This project involved talking to customers to understand their requirements, deciding what technologies to use, building a prototype, and working with other team members to integrate the final implementation into additional features.

What We’re Building

As engineers, we are used to tooling that makes us better at what we do. When we started Ashby, we saw the opposite with Talent Acquisition software. Recruiting teams were leveling up how they did their work, but instead of software meeting this new standard, it held them back.

Scheduling a final round is an excellent example. Recruiting teams wanted to schedule candidates faster, track interviewer preparation and quality, and do it with half the headcount. A recruiter needed to manually collect availability from the candidate, identify qualified interviewers, perform Calendar Tetris to find who is available to interview the candidate, schedule on the earliest date possible, and make any last-minute adjustments as availability changed. They must do this while considering the interview load on each individual and whether interviewers need to be trained and shadowing others. TA software didn’t help.

As hiring managers, we know TA is a critical function, and as engineers, we know software can do better. So, we built and continue to build Ashby to give TA teams the highest standard of tooling. Software that’s intelligent and powerful. Software that provides insights into where they’re failing and automates or simplifies many of the tasks they’re underwater with. We want other functions and departments to be jealous of what TA teams can do with Ashby, and today they often are!

Why You Should or Shouldn’t Apply

Software engineers come in many flavors, not all of which fit our model. Here are some things to help you decide if this fits you and what you’re looking for:

  • You’re not afraid to tackle any part of a technology stack. You do what’s necessary to successfully deliver a feature, whether writing frontend or choosing new infrastructure. We’ll provide a supportive environment to do it successfully (e.g., design system, SRE team).
  • You’ve tackled projects with a lot of product and technical ambiguity, and you thrive at the intersection of the two. We’re not building a simple CRUD app, and many of the challenges we tackle require you to use your knowledge of our customers to build powerful abstractions and flexibility in the system to solve a class of problems.
  • You know how to strike the right balance between speed and quality. Ashby wasn’t built quickly. We took four years to launch publicly because convincing customers to switch required a high-quality product. However, time isn’t infinite, especially for a startup, so we still move with urgency—we’ve built the equivalent of three or more VC-backed startups with a very small team.
  • You are ambitious and always looking to improve your skills. For most engineers, this role will give you more freedom and responsibilities than you’ve experienced in the past. To thrive (and level up), you’ll need to be open to feedback (and we give lots of it).
  • You’re an excellent collaborator and communicator. Ownership and freedom don’t mean you work in a vacuum. You’ll need to vet your decisions with the appropriate stakeholders, keep them up to date when necessary, and work with other engineers to get your projects across the finish line. Clear and concise communication helps a lot here!
  • You seek to create leverage in your work. The nature of software is that you can often automate or abstract what would be tedious, time-consuming work. Your impatience usually leads to new abstractions, tools to allow Support to debug before Engineering, new lint rules to prevent common bugs, etc.

Put another way, you shouldn’t apply if:

  • You’re not in a position to contribute without company-driven process and structure. Our most tenured engineers spend most of their time building, and we often trust them with our most challenging problems. While they lead product and technical areas and help other engineers plan their most challenging work, it’s not a requirement, nor do engineers need their sign-off.
  • You need company-driven process and structure to get your projects across the finish line. Sprint planning and well-defined project management processes are things you need or look to others to lead. You’d rather focus on the technical details and challenges.
  • You only want to do exciting work. We’re building a team of kind, collaborative folks. Customer issues and investigations are distributed across the team, including our high-level ICs.
  • You can get lost in the details. Once you start implementation, it can be hard to take a step back and think about the project as a whole. You like everything to be planned upfront.
  • You haven’t led or taken ownership of projects before. You’re used to working with tech leads and taking on tasks distributed by them.
  • You want to mentor earlier-career engineers. We rely on engineers owning their projects, so we need engineers with that experience. This requires the team to be reasonably tenured. More than 90% of the team would be considered Senior or above in the industry today, so mentorship opportunities are very limited.

Engineering Culture

Our engineering culture is motivated by Benji’s and my belief that a small, talented team, given the right environment, can build high-quality software fast (and work regular hours!). We do it through:

  • Minimal process with ownership over decisions normally made by product and design
  • Natural collaboration and deliberate communication
  • Investing in tools and abstractions that give us leverage
  • Putting effort into building a diverse team

Minimal Process & Lots of Ownership

The best engineers we’ve worked with delivered reliably magical outcomes. They took customer problems and relentlessly drove them to solutions that were not only successful but often brilliant and creative. While they did this with minimal oversight, stakeholders were never in the dark as to what was going on, and no setback was a surprise.

Traditional product-development processes aren’t meant for the best engineers. Their purpose is to create consistent outcomes regardless of the engineer’s skill. But, consistency comes at the expense of an engineer’s time and freedom—both ingredients necessary to generate those magical outcomes. As a result, process stifles the best engineers and doesn’t give others the opportunity to practice the behaviors that made the best engineers the “best.”

At Ashby, we want to build an environment that encourages every engineer to be their best. So, at Ashby, every Engineer runs their project. Product Managers (and Designers) build strategy, do customer research, and hand off problem briefs to Engineers. Engineers take on the rest: they research the problem, write product specs, build wireframes, and implement their solution end-to-end. We rely on engineers, not process, to push information outward to the relevant folks (e.g., Product Managers) and pull folks in to help (e.g., Designers, Infra). It’s a new level of ownership for many engineers, but we’d rather an engineer fail a bit and coach up their skills than use process as a crutch. Not everyone succeeds in our culture, but those who do thrive.

Collaboration is Natural & Communication is Deliberate

Our engineering team consists of lifelong learners who are talented but also humble and kind (meet them here!). These attributes create an environment where collaboration happens naturally. We combine this with research, prototyping, and written proposals to see around corners and get feedback from the team across time zones. Focus time is something that we hold sacred, and, with thoughtful and deliberate communication, engineers are in <2h meetings per week (I wrote about it here).

To drive it home, here is a recent calendar of an engineer who has been with us for over 4 years:

We also meet in person at least twice a year, once as a department and once as a company. You also have a small budget to meet up with folks in your city/region.

Increase Leverage, not Team Size

We built Ashby with the quality, breadth, and depth that many customers would expect from much larger teams over larger time scales. We’ve done this through investment in:

  • Great developer tooling. Our CI/CD takes ~10m, and we deploy at least 15x a day. A debugger that works out of the box. Everyone on the team has contributed to our developer experience.
  • Building blocks to create powerful and customizable products fast. At the core of Ashby is a set of common components (analytics modeling and query language, policy engine, workflow engine, design system) that we constantly improve. Each improvement to a common component cascades throughout our app (short video below).

Here’s an impromptu quote from Arjun in our company Slack of what it’s like to build a feature at Ashby:

And a demo of one of these building blocks:

Put Effort into Diversity

Diverse teams drive innovation and better outcomes. Having seen my mother and partner build their careers as minority women in non-diverse fields, I want to make sure Ashby creates opportunities for the next generation of engineers from underrepresented groups.

Today, 21% of engineers at Ashby are from underrepresented groups. It’s not great, and we are taking conscious steps to improve, like sourcing diverse candidates, providing generous paid family leave, no leetcode interviews, and more.

Interview Process

At Ashby, our team and interview process want to help you show your best self. We’ll dive into past projects and simulate working together via pair programming, writing product and tech specs collaboratively, and talking through decisions. There are no leetcode or whiteboard exercises.

Our interview process is three rounds:

  • Introduction call with Hiring Manager (15 to 30m, live)
  • A technical screen where we pair in our actual codebase (1h, live)
  • Three non-coding interviews that focus on product thinking, technical design, and infrastructure (3h 15m, live can be split across multiple days)

Depending on our leadership team’s bandwidth, we may start with an additional 30m screen with a recruiter.

Your hiring manager will be your main point of contact and prep you for interviews. Each round will have written guidance so you know what to expect (you’ll need minimal preparation). You’ll meet 4 to 6 people in engineering (with 5-15 minutes in each interview to ask them questions). If we don’t give an offer, we’ll provide feedback!

Your First Three Months at Ashby

We want an exceptional onboarding experience for every new hire. At Ashby, your dev environment is set up with a single script, you push your first product change on day one, and you spend the rest of your time shipping product changes that give you a tour of our codebase and best practices. The product changes increase in scope and ambiguity from simple copy changes to the delivery of a prominent, impactful feature. Your manager will do a 30, 60, and 90-day review to give feedback and calibrate on how we work together.

It’s a team effort to get you successfully onboarded; you’ll have a peer paired with you to answer questions, pair program, and check in often to see if you need help. The rest of the team will run training sessions on our culture, product, engineering process, and technical architecture.

Technology Stack

I’m sharing our tech stack with the caveat that we don’t require previous experience in it (but a love of typed languages is helpful): TypeScript (frontend & backend), React, GraphQL API, Node.js, Postgres, Redis.

When they joined Ashby, many of our engineers switched from other languages like Swift and Kotlin. We care more about fundamentals (e.g., debugging, abstractions) and how fast you learn. For folks on the team who switched, it’s nice seeing changes hot reload versus waiting for XCode to compile.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and equity.
  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.
  • Unlimited PTO, and we will encourage you to take it.
  • A minimum of 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave, covered by Ashby. For folks outside the US, it may be longer to be in line with regional requirements.
  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!
  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.
  • If you’re in the US, we offer top-tier health insurance for you and your dependents, with 100% of premiums covered by Ashby. In other countries, we provide high-quality supplemental health insurance for you and your dependents, also fully covered by us.

Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Experiências que, somadas, chegam a R$5 bilhões concedidos até hoje. Open Co é bem mais que empréstimo. É poder de compra para que indivíduos e PMEs possam evoluir junto com o Brasil. Todos os dias.

title: GTE CONTROLE CUSTOS
description:
Job Purpose

The Project Controller Manager will be responsible for all project financial controls in large EPCI projects, utilizing the management tools available at TechnipFMC. He/she will oversee forecast and financial results, aiming to enhance the lookahead culture, ensure project financial consistency, and align with corporate rules.

Job Description

  1. Establish the project budget based on tender handover information.
  2. Support package managers with financial analysis such as LOP forecast.
  3. Estimate total forecasts, including quantities, costs, revenues, currency, and expected outcomes.
  4. Prepare project LOP forecasts, anticipate deviations, and support mitigation plans and decision-making by PCM and Project Director.
  5. Prepare project performance analysis.
  6. Generate monthly internal Project Management Review (PMR).
  7. Approve standard commitment controls and vendor/subcontractor invoices according to system workflows.
  8. Manage a team of up to 10 Project Controllers.
  9. Support VOR & CSA preparations.
  10. Prepare monthly cash flows.
  11. Ensure cost accounting reconciliation.
  12. Forecast project P&L (revenue/GM per quarter) in collaboration with packages/PCM and providers, providing main justifications if needed.
  13. Monitor project financial results, including revenue/GM recognition, external accruals, schedule C analysis, and backlog.
  14. Consolidate financial statements (P&L segmentation) for multi-entity projects.
  15. Prepare actual and forecasted cash flows per entity and currency, with justifications.
  16. Manage project hedging operations and ensure monthly hedge account processes.
  17. Ensure compliance with SOX requirements, IFRS15, contract analysis, and balance sheet reviews.
  18. Respond to internal controls and external audits.
  19. Coordinate with REMS and unify revenue reporting across entities.
  20. Support project teams on financial topics and assist with tax-related issues (WHT, PIT, change in law).
  21. Ensure financial consistency and alignment with corporate policies.
  22. Develop and maintain systems for revenue and cost measurement, reporting data, and improve feedback and estimation tools for future contracts.
  23. Prepare project close-out reports to enhance future contract estimations.

Qualifications

  • Master's/Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, or equivalent.
  • Experience in finance or financial controlling, with ERP systems.
  • Fluent in English.
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS standards, especially IAS 11, IAS 18, IAS 21, IAS 32, IAS 39.
  • Solid understanding of accounting concepts.
  • Ability to work independently and in teams.

Skills Communication, Project Management

Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para condução de veículo a serviço da empresa (atividade regulamentada pelo CTB código de trânsito brasileiro), suporte à equipe e acompanhamento das atividades operacionais, e percepção auditiva para atendimento telefônico e aos colaboradores e detecção de sinais sonoros emergenciais em áreas operacionais.

Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.

Responsabilidades

  • Liderar a equipe de operadores de equipamentos e agentes de bagagem e rampa, promovendo o desenvolvimento profissional do grupo (formação de sucessores), coordenar as atividades e processos inerentes ao atendimento de aeronaves em solo (chegada e partida), atuando em conjunto com as demais áreas envolvidas na operação visando garantir a pontualidade do voo com qualidade e segurança, segundo as normas e procedimentos publicados no MGO, realizar o procedimento de inspeção visual na fuselagem da aeronave nas chegadas e partidas (walkaround);
  • Coletar, compilar e compartilhar antecipadamente com os demais colaboradores da equipe, dados e informações referentes à operação a ser processada, definir e atribuir responsabilidades ao grupo de trabalho de maneira planejada, analisando a operação in loco, estabelecendo objetivos de acordo com a priorização de demandas e atividades;
  • Analyzar as irregularidades ou situações de risco identificadas, atuando na correção e prevenção através da realização de briefings operacionais e do reporte para demais setores envolvidos;
  • Identificar e reportar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos de rampa, seja de maneira micro e/ou macro, realizar briefings operacionais e comportamentais, promover reuniões, dar feedback;
  • Coordenar todas as atividades pertinentes à movimentação de equipamentos de rampa durante o descarregamento e carregamento de bagagens e cargas das aeronaves, orientando os colaboradores durante as operações quanto à logística de atividades, análises de sinistralidades e agindo frente a possíveis ocorrências a fim de evitar rupturas operacionais e perda de qualidade nos serviços executados.

  • Realizar visitas e atendimentos em outros ambulatórios da TRANSPETRO conforme demanda e necessidade do serviço; realizar convocação no prontuário informatizado de saúde para exames ocupacionais com emissão de guias quando necessário.
  • Realizar o preenchimento da CAT – Comunicação de Acidente de Trabalho no site da Previdência Social, com inserção de dados no sistema informatizado de Saúde.
  • Realizar inspeções ocupacionais e/ou higiênico-sanitárias nos ambulatórios e Enfermarias dos Navios da Transpetro com emissão de relatórios; preparar e executar apresentações de DSMS sobre temas específicos de saúde.
  • Participar do controle de medicamentos, materiais e equipamentos dos ambulatórios e Enfermarias dos Navios; lançar resultados de exames complementares e dados de campanhas de saúde no sistema informatizado de saúde.
  • Desempenhar tarefas relacionadas aos programas de promoção de saúde; gerenciamento de resíduos; programas de educação; apoiar o acompanhamento de tratamentos de doenças, observando sintomas, reações e medidas adotadas.
  • Realizar Testagem Toxicológica para pesquisa de drogas na ocasião dos exames admissionais de Processo Seletivo Público de mar.
  • Participar de reuniões, teleconferências, simulados de emergência, videoconferências e reuniões de investigação de acidente de trabalho quando demandado.
  • Controlar a maleta de emergência dos ambulatórios com checklist; emitir relatórios inerentes às rotinas e características do serviço; gerenciar filas e marcação de empregados para a realização dos exames ocupacionais.
  • Cumprir e fazer cumprir todos os procedimentos legais, bem como as normas e instruções normativas da PETROBRAS e da TRANSPETRO.
  • Consolidar conhecimentos em BLS – Basic Life Support, atualizado bienalmente a partir da data de realização; possuir conhecimentos em informática.

Requisitos e experiência

  • Experiência acima de 06 (seis) anos em Serviços de Enfermagem.

Sobre o Grupo Med+

Junte-se ao Grupo Med+ – Onde o propósito salva vidas! Somos o Grupo Med+, a maior empresa de Emergency Response para infraestruturas críticas no Brasil. Com mais de 6.000 colaboradores espalhados por todo o território nacional, protegemos e cuidamos da vida de mais de 56 milhões de pessoas que transitam diariamente por aeroportos, rodovias, shoppings, escolas, empresas, mineradoras e petrolíferas. Cada colaborador, ou Med Member, carrega a responsabilidade e o orgulho de fazer parte de algo maior: salvar vidas todos os dias. Originados em Brasília e com mais de 17 anos de história, criamos soluções em Urgência e Emergência, Saúde Corporativa e Prevenção e Combate a Incêndios, transformando o cuidado com a vida em um propósito compartilhado.

  • Propósito: aqui você não apenas trabalha, você transforma realidades.
  • Pertencimento: cultura de cuidado, energia e inovação.
  • Crescimento: oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo.
  • Impacto: suas ações fazem a diferença na vida de milhares de pessoas.

Confira as vagas disponíveis e venha construir um futuro brilhante conosco! Aqui, seu talento encontra um propósito. Acompanhe-nos também nas nossas redes sociais e fique por dentro das novidades: Grupo Med+ – Prontos para salvar. Em qualquer lugar do Brasil.

Main responsibilities

Atuar de forma estratégica e operacional na gestão contábil e fiscal da companhia, assegurando conformidade com normas contábeis e tributárias, cumprimento das obrigações acessórias e geração de informações confiáveis para suportar a tomada de decisão da empresa.

  • Executar e revisar conciliações contábeis complexas, assegurando a integridade e acuracidade das informações.
  • Elaborar e analisar demonstrações financeiras, de acordo com as normas societárias e internacionais (BRGAAP/IFRS).
  • Coordenar e validar lançamentos contábeis, provisões, reclassificações e ajustes de fechamento mensal.
  • Apurar impostos retidos na fonte (IR, PCC e INSS).
  • Apurar impostos diretos sobre faturamento (PIS/COFINS, IRPJ e CSLL).
  • Apurar e controlar créditos de PIS/COFINS.
  • Conferir a contabilização dos impostos apurados pelo fiscal (ICMS, IPI e ISS).
  • Controlar prazos, preparar e enviar declarações acessórias, tais como: DCTF, EFD Contribuições, DIRF, ECF, ECD, REINF, IBGE, SISCOSERV e PERDCOMP.
  • Emitir certidões negativas junto à Receita Federal e demais órgãos competentes.
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo informações e documentos necessários.
  • Produzir relatórios gerenciais e análises de performance contábil e fiscal para suporte à tomada de decisão.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos e controles internos da área.

Competências Técnicas

  • Sólido conhecimento em normas contábeis (CPC/IFRS).
  • Experiência em fechamento contábil e elaboração de demonstrações financeiras.
  • Forte domínio em legislação tributária, apuração de impostos e obrigações acessórias.
  • Habilidade em conferência e integração entre rotinas contábeis e fiscais.
  • Conhecimento em conciliações contábeis, créditos tributários e controles internos.

Focada em tecnologia, também saiu na frente do setor ao oferecer soluções como web check-in, wi-fi no carro, chatbot nas redes sociais e tecnologia de pagamento contactless em todos os veículos.

Empresa da SIMPAR, hoje faz parte da Movida Participações, criada em 2015 para administrar as operações de Aluguel de Carros, Venda de Seminovos e de Gestão de Terceirização de Frotas de veículos leves.

A Movida se diferencia pelo seu "jeitão" inovador e descomplicado. Carrega em seu DNA o foco no cliente e a sua GENTE como prioridade!

A Movida (MOVI3) é uma empresa de aluguel de carros que oferece soluções inovadoras em mobilidade urbana para todo tipo de necessidade. Pioneira em oferecer serviços como aluguel mensal para pessoa física, Wi-Fi no carro, pré-pagamento e ChatBot nas redes sociais, foi a primeira locadora do país a ir além do carro, ajudando a revolucionar o setor de locação no Brasil. Antenada aos novos tempos, investe em sustentabilidade, sendo a primeira locadora de veículos no mundo, listada em bolsa, a receber a Certificação de Empresa B, fazendo parte de um seleto grupo de companhias que têm como modelo de negócios o desenvolvimento socioambiental. No Brasil, foi a primeira a ter um programa como o Carbon Free, que neutraliza as emissões de CO2 das locações dos seus clientes.

Desde 2006 no mercado, a Movida foi adquirida em 2013 pela JSL, abriu capital em fevereiro de 2017 e hoje é uma das empresas da SIMPAR S.A. Com perfil inovador aliado a forte governança corporativa, atua tanto no varejo, com aluguel de carros, como no mercado corporativo, com a terceirização de frotas para empresas, além da venda de seminovos. Overview

Join to apply for the Medical Assistant-3 role at Inside Higher Ed

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Basic Function

Under the supervision of the Practice Office Manager/Supervisor, the Medical Assistant assists the Physicians in the care and treatment of patients and is responsible for the maintenance of examination rooms, medical/surgical supplies and equipment.

Supervisory Accountability

Involves no responsibility or authority for the direction of others.

Nature And Scope

External contacts include a variety of third party payers, medical organizations, patients and other healthcare personnel.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Prepares patients for medical appointments including obtaining and recording patients’ vital signs.
  • Prepares instruments and equipment for use in examinations and/or medical/surgical procedures.
  • Assists Physicians with examinations and medical procedures.
  • Clean and dress wounds, remove sutures as requested by a Physician.
  • Observes patients and reports adverse reactions to medication or treatment to medical personnel in charge.
  • Collect samples, taken by physician for testing, and deliver them to the laboratory.
  • Cleans, disinfects, and sterilizes materials, instruments, equipment, rooms and supplies.
  • Inventories and requisitions supplies.
  • Reviews patient charts for instructions regarding prescriptions, tests, follow-up appointments and/or patient testing procedures.
  • Schedules patients for follow-up testing procedures.
  • Obtains pre-certification/authorization for surgical procedures, admissions, etc.
  • Assist in locating and filing records.
  • Retrieves lab reports, dictations, x-rays and correspondence. Files and maintains orderly records.
  • Provides patient education and instruction as directed by the Physician. Makes decisions and judgments on phone calls, answering questions and advising patients with Physicians guidelines. Instructs patient in preparation for procedures and in-home care, using instruction sheets when applicable.
  • Answers telephone, takes messages, and gives routine information in accordance with established procedures.
  • Maintains knowledge of and complies with established policies and procedures.
  • Maintains work area in a neat and orderly manner. Performs other related duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Knowledge of examination, diagnostic and treatment room procedures.
  • Knowledge of Medical Terminology.
  • Knowledgeable in the use of CPT and ICD-9 code reference books.
  • Knowledge of common safety hazards and precautions to maintain a safe work environment.
  • Demonstrated skill in oral and written communications as well as ability to speak clearly.
  • Skill in assisting in a variety of treatments and medications as directed. Skill in taking vital signs.
  • Skill in maintaining records and recording test results.
  • Skill in establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with patients, medical staff, and the public.
  • Ability to be detailed oriented, follow established priorities or procedures, and deliver quality customer service.
  • Ability to use good judgment, make sound decisions and behave with tact, decorum and diplomacy.
  • Ability to maintain quality control standards.
  • Ability to react calmly and effectively in emergency situations.
  • Ability to read, understand and respond to oral and written instructions.

Minimum Requirements

  • Associate’s degree in Medical Technology, Nursing or related field or two (2) years related experience in a physician’s office, clinic and/or hospital or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Certification or Registration as a Medical Technology also required.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Para compor o quadro de profissionais para atender ao Hospital da Maternidade Paulino Werneck. Na função de Técnico de Enfermagem-CC desempenhando as seguintes funções: incentiva a proteção e promoção do aleitamento materno, cuidado integral individual e humanizado ao cliente e família, prestar assistência de acordo com as metas internacionais de segurança do paciente, práticas de humanização, normas e rotinas institucionais, exercer atividades de organização setorial, controle de equipamentos, transporte interno de pacientes e/ou materiais biológicos, limpezas concorrentes e terminais. Deve cumprir normas de apresentação pessoal, comunicação cordial e empática, manter rigoroso comportamento ético-profissional, participar dos treinamentos e programas de atualização fornecidos pela instituição e colocar em prática os conhecimentos adquiridos. Realizar o registro de todas as informações no prontuário ou impresso padronizado pela instituição, solicitar presença do enfermeiro sempre que for necessário, em situações emergenciais ou imprevistas, avaliar antecipadamente a programação cirúrgica, assegurando a disponibilidade de todo o material cirúrgico necessário, verificar o estoque de material esterilizado, monitorando as datas de esterilização, receber e orientar pacientes e acompanhantes na admissão, explicando a rotina da unidade, preparar a Sala de Operação com os recursos necessários, verificar a temperatura da sala cirúrgica, facilitar o transporte e posicionamento do paciente na mesa de cirurgia, preservando sua privacidade e garantindo a permeabilidade de cateteres e sondas, auxiliar a equipe cirúrgica durante a paramentação e disponibilizar materiais e instrumentais estéreis, garantir o correto posicionamento da placa dispersiva de energia do eletrocautério, verificar o sistema de gases e auxiliar o anestesista durante a indução e reversão da anestesia, exercer as funções de circulante de sala, identificar material para exames anatomopatológicos e encaminhá-lo para serviço especializado, com registro adequado, apoiar o médico neonatologista nos cuidados imediatos do recém-nascido, incluindo a correta identificação com pulseiras e verificação do nome da mãe, desmontar a sala operatória e encaminhar materiais contaminados ao Centro de Material e Esterilização (CME), solicitar limpeza concorrente ou terminal da Sala de Operação, conforme necessário.

Requisitos

  • Curso Técnico em Enfermagem com COREN ativo.
  • Experiência mínima de 6 (seis) meses como Técnico de Enfermagem em rotinas hospitalares, preferencialmente linha materno infantil (Pronto socorro de ginecologia e obstetrícia, alojamento conjunto centro obstétrico e centro cirúrgico).
  • Desejável conhecimento em aleitamento materno e cursos complementares.
  • Conhecimento de informática nível intermediário (pacote Office).
  • Desejável conhecimento em Sistemas de Saúde - Prontuário eletrônico.

  • Benefícios: vale alimentação, refeição no local, seguro de vida, auxílio funeral, convênios com faculdade e SESC, auxílio creche, vale transporte, plano odontológico, plano de saúde.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We have created a new leadership role, Partner Marketing Director, to drive our Go-To-Market strategy across our partner ecosystem, from silicon to public cloud, through channel and hardware manufacturers. As the publisher of Ubuntu and the leading provider of open source to major technology firms globally, we play a unique role in a variety of innovative value chains (Public Cloud, Cybersecurity, AI, IoT) supporting our partners both technically and commercially.
Reporting to the VP of Marketing you will lead a team of marketing managers running partner programs. You will work closely with our partners to make Canonical their trusted partner to deliver open source based products and solutions. In this role you will ultimately be responsible for maximising the overall ROI of our campaigns supporting our partners motions whether sell-to, sell-through or sell-with.
The partner marketing team is formed of multi-talented marketing professionals, as comfortable formulating joint value propositions as they are about running lead generation campaigns. They have an eye for creating remarkable messages/assets and a hand in the selection of the most effective channels through a complex supply chain. They are passionate about technology, the users of enterprise technology, and are early adopters of advanced partner analytics technologies.

 This role is home based in the AMER region.

  • Strong understanding of the technology ecosystem including Silicon, IHV, ISV, ODM/OEMs, cloud service providers and channels is essential for this role.
  • Demonstrated leadership in aligning diverse partners around Go To Market strategies.
  • Proven track record of developing and executing successful co-marketing programs in the technology space.
  • Experience reporting on complex partner marketing activities and touchpoints.
  • Ability to create a culture of excellence, agility and self-drive in your team.
  • Curiosity with a habit of continuous learning.
  • Outstanding communications skills in English, both verbal and written.
  • Exceptional academic results both at high school and university.
  • Willingness to travel internationally up to 4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long.

title: General Foreman
description:
General Foreman - Civil | UAE


Are you a hands-on construction leader with deep structural experience and a drive for delivering high-quality work on time, every time?


This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia


Who We are?

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises


In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.


ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.


Why Join Us?

As a General Foreman , you’ll lead multiple structural work zones, from formwork and concrete to steel and blockwork. You’ll manage a team of Senior Foremen, ensuring all structural activities are planned, resourced, executed, and handed over to the highest technical and safety standards. Your role is critical to coordinating construction efforts, maintaining productivity, and upholding ALEC’s commitment to quality and environmental compliance.


About Your Team

You’ll report to the Section Manager and lead teams of Senior Foremen, Foremen, and labour across various structural disciplines. You’ll work closely with planning, procurement, safety, and QA/QC teams to ensure seamless execution across all phases of work.


Your Role

As a General Foreman, you will:

  • Lead and support Foremen in managing labour and tradesmen across all structural work fronts.
  • Interpret structural drawings and ensure accurate site setup and execution.
  • Plan resources effectively and manage site access, logistics, and emergency readiness.
  • Ensure the timely procurement and correct usage of construction materials and plant.
  • Enforce ALEC’s safety policies, ensuring work is carried out using the proper PPE and safety procedures.
  • Manage heavy equipment and ensure only qualified operators handle machinery.
  • Coordinate across structural teams including carpentry, steel, rebar, blockwork, and concrete.
  • Drive productivity initiatives, ensuring teams work at optimal efficiency.
  • Lead by example, coach site teams, and identify upskilling needs for unskilled labour.
  • Ensure compliance with ISO standards, carry out quality audits, and implement corrective actions.
  • Support environmental management before, during, and after construction phases.
  • Oversee the structural handover process with complete documentation and quality verification.


What We’re Looking For

  • Experience :
    10+ years in construction with at least 2 years as a Senior Foreman, specifically in structural works.
  • Certifications :
    First Aider qualification is required.
  • Technical Knowledge :
    Strong understanding of structural works including formwork, blockwork, rebar, and carpentry.
  • Leadership :
    Proven ability to manage large, multi-disciplinary site teams and interface with support functions.
  • Planning & Coordination :
    Skilled in short-term planning, resource control, and progress tracking.
  • Communication :
    Effective communicator who builds trust across teams and levels.
  • Safety & Quality :
    Committed to site safety and consistent delivery to quality standards.


What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.
